name: pysms_ramsey_clique_avoid5_indset_avoid3_vertices14__v24
prompt:
Generate a graph with 14 vertices that contains no clique of size 5 and no independent set of size 3. (A Ramsey-witness graph: such graphs exist iff vertices < R(clique_avoid, indset_avoid).)

Return the graph as a list of edges (u, v) with 0 <= u < v < 14, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no graph exists.
